limitations: Abstract scheduled observers only; no physical sensor validation or weapon effectiveness claim.
Expected slots include active actors whose configured delivery time falls within the recorded interval; scheduled misses are included and reported separately.
Lateness threshold is configured delivery plus 1000 virtual ms; gateway publication may add delay at accelerated clock scales.
Position error uses zero-order held sealed snapshots at or before sample time; error is unavailable unless sample and snapshot times match exactly.
Track errors count recorded merge/fragmentation relationships, not semantic classification correctness. Missing denominators are null, never zero scores.
Scenario completion means runtime COMPLETED; workflow completion counts command outcomes independently. Cancelled/failed runs remain partial exercises.

evaluation.timeBasis: integer virtual milliseconds; received_at is independent wall receipt time

operatorManifest.replayGuarantee: Ordered recorded output at virtual milliseconds and journal sequence; no command execution or re-simulation. Checkpoints restore selected recorded state only.

limitations: Fixture performance is not a maximum-scale benchmark.
Checkpoint compatibility restores selected recorded output; no runtime lease takeover or process restoration.
Public replay requires current unrestricted source and full COP read grants for the exact run; truth needs separate current grants.
Capture/serialization/checkpoint/identity-history budgets fail visibly; one final archive and three worker attempts per run.
90-day archive read window; no physical deletion daemon is claimed. Immutable evidence and released summaries follow administrative backup/retention.
Virtual-time seek renders at most 200 rows per layer and at most 8 MiB per frame, with explicit truncation and paged complete event history.
Historical identity changes retain wall time, with a final virtual archive anchor; migration baselines do not invent earlier entitlement times.
Perception/workflow models remain abstract; no physical sensor, specialist physics or hardware-control claim.
proofs: Compiled native process; permitted reference/context; frozen scene; synthetic perception; mission-linked HOLD completion; classification history.
Separate scoped output/truth journals, hashed archives and selected-state checkpoints; exact denominator/sample/association checks.
Frame reads preserve original evidence/commands and ignore post-archive COP edits.
Interrupted archive retry, corrupted content, source-restricted/cross-run/revoked/expired reads, heartbeat deduplication, checkpoint incompatibility.
Explicit evaluator authorization/audit; bounded private identity history excludes credential hashes; deliberate idempotent numeric release.
Local evaluator grants require explicit CLI flag; ordinary administration remains denied by default.
Preset save/reapply/freeze/edit, immutable revision identity and unchanged seeded sampling baseline.
Real-backend desktop/mobile workflows without mocked domain APIs.
